search_intent.question: What permits or prevents a single existing organism from reaching another meal under the current material, action-energy and momentum laws?
search_intent.proposed_use: Paid diagnostic motor inputs, matched medium/budget interventions, privileged oracle, sensor-only comparators and optional bounded sensing

provenance.type: Repository source and preserved deterministic experiments; no external scientific research performed
provenance.M4_evidence: docs/m5/M4_EVIDENCE_AUDIT.json records all 1732 artifact SHA256 checks, complete 427-trial replay and later original-law compatibility replay
provenance.limitations: No publication or biological finding validates the kinematic rig, authored lunge, action-energy proxy, oral capture stencil, new sensor or controller competence. No literature was silently consulted.

knowledge_transfer.origin: NeuralState::integrate and World::advance at the committed checkpoint
knowledge_transfer.claim: Physical reachability must use actual smoothing, billing and world feeding; M4 imposed-body assays bypassed metabolism
knowledge_transfer.implementation: Validated tick_controlled substitutes raw requests before the same muscle/cost path; ordinary tick passes no diagnostic input
knowledge_transfer.deviation_or_assumption: Target-aware control is external to the organism; its command stream is part of replay input

knowledge_transfer.claim: Mouth articulation plus rounded-head capture can consume distant-site food without substantial COM travel
knowledge_transfer.implementation: Continuous COM/mouth telemetry, exact ingestion eligibility audit, explicit founding bite and second-site benchmarks
knowledge_transfer.deviation_or_assumption: Capture is lattice distance squared <=2 after rounding, not continuous mesh contact or jaw closure

chronology: M4 reviewed and artifact bytes checked before edits; initial protocol saved before executed M5 trials. Controlled screening, periodic controls and oracle/local benchmark preceded sensor introduction. Protocol amendments disclose the independent local motor-model comparator and optional sensor. Exploration seed1 is included again in eight-seed confirmation; there is no blinded holdout/generalization study. All failed target-reaching conditions preserved. Raw evidence bundled after user raised 10k Git-file count; per-file hashes verified before moving expanded copies to local cache. Archives reconstruct every original raw file.

evidence_status.CONSULTED: Committed project source and complete M4 evidence; no external publications
evidence_status.IMPLEMENTED: Paid raw motor input, read-only ordinary sensor ABI, isolated oracle/local prototypes, optional bounded directional sensor; no body/energy/material/momentum-law or production-controller change
evidence_status.VALIDATED_MECHANISMS: Exact replay, independent per-tick energy/material/momentum and capture audits, backward compatibility, braking/heading interventions, bounded/rotating/off-axis sensor tests
evidence_status.VALIDATED_OBSERVATIONS: Oracle second-meal target reaching in 24/96 designed runs; local model with old rays 8/96, optional lobes 9/96. Most successes are mouth articulation with <0.023 sites COM motion before ingestion
evidence_status.NULLS: Most placements fail; all tested production recurrent/random/rest/pulse local baselines fail distant target; forward three-site fixture fails all 372 default-budget open-loop screen/periodic controls. These finite failures do not prove universal physical impossibility
evidence_status.NOT_DEMONSTRATED: General 3D navigation, reliable stopping at arbitrary food, production autonomous foraging, learned improvement, sparse-habitat viability, continuous physical food contact, realistic hydrodynamics

not_run: Initially listed256 amplitude /32-tick single-pulse screen cells and512-tick high-energy horizon were not executed. Actual matrices are in saved results and REPORT. No exhaustive optimum/reachable-set claim.
computational_boundary: Oracle/model prediction runs externally in the harness. Existing neural fee is retained; extra planner CPU cost is not a separate metabolic charge. This is not proof that the original eight neurons implement the model controller or that its biological computation is efficient.
